email_subject: Application - RIAT Digital Service Design Officer
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the RIAT Digital Service Design Officer position at the Return and Reintegration Facility. With a background in digital marketing, web development, and a strong focus on user-centered design, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to the continued development of the Reintegration Assistance Tool.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills in translating user needs into actionable requirements, conducting technical audits, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. My experience building and optimizing WordPress sites, implementing structured data, and improving search visibility has given me a solid foundation in digital service design principles. I am particularly drawn to the RIAT's mission to support EU Member States in managing reintegration assistance, and I am eager to apply my analytical and coordination skills to facilitate discovery activities and support the development process.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am comfortable working in English. I am also learning Dutch and Turkish is my native language. I am confident that my technical background and passion for improving digital services make me a strong fit for this role.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to the RIAT team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in the RIAT Digital Service Design Officer position at the Return and Reintegration Facility. With a background in digital marketing, web development, and a strong focus on user-centered design, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to the continued development of the Reintegration Assistance Tool (RIAT).

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have developed a comprehensive skill set that aligns well with the responsibilities of this position. I am responsible for on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content creation, and full-cycle WordPress site builds and maintenance. This work requires translating user needs and operational workflows into clear development requirements, a skill directly applicable to the RIAT DEV process. I am also experienced in conducting technical audits and using analytics tools to inform decisions, which would support the discovery and prioritization activities of the role.

My own project, mirook.com, has further honed my abilities in digital service design. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on experience has given me a deep understanding of how to align technical considerations with user needs, a core aspect of the RIAT Digital Service Design Officer role.

I am particularly drawn to the RIAT's mission to support EU Member States in strengthening their return and reintegration systems. The opportunity to work within a governance framework alongside the European Commission, EU Member States, and Frontex is both challenging and inspiring. I am confident that my technical foundation, analytical mindset, and collaborative approach would enable me to effectively support the RIAT Senior Project Manager and contribute to the tool's evolution.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am comfortable working in English. I am also learning Dutch and Turkish is my native language. I am eager to bring my skills to the RRF team and am available for an interview at your convenience.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to the RIAT's success.

Sincerely,

Digital Service Design · SEO · GEO · Content · Web

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core skills
- Digital service design: translating user needs into requirements, discovery activities, prioritization, coordination
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
